g.id: cluster_Clinic file: /clinic-data.json, or the edited copy in frontdesk.clinic
g.text: Clinic file: /clinic-data.json, or the edited copy in frontdesk.clinic
bot_rules : string[] (sent to the model only)
status : urgent | needs human | answered | closed
bookingTime : string ("" when not a booking)
frontdesk.alerts : "1" (v1.1, only when staff turn urgent alerts on)
human (v1.1, asks for a person) : needs human
A staff reply moves it on
the reply, kind and status never change.
Optional. A file without it keeps the
standard name and the seven standard
frontdesk.clinic when it holds an object
with a clinic section, else the shipped
